title: GTA 6 Running Log
summary: A running, topic-organised log of GTA 6 facts from our chats plus researched codes, locations, and secrets. Progress: Chapter 1, up to Discharge Time. Updated 26 Nov 2026, 3:16 PM AEST.
calloutBody: Items marked Our chats came from Tyas in this conversation and are listed exactly as given. Items with a link were added from post-launch guides and should be treated as community-sourced until confirmed in-game. Ordinary store-robbery keypad codes are randomised and are not listed. This page was built as the first research update on 21 Nov 2026, Australia/Brisbane.

categories.heading: Codes
categories.caption: Safe, door, and keypad codes. Tyas's three Port Gellhorn codes match launch guides. Mission codes are generally fixed; free-roam store safes are not. Cheat codes are D-pad entries on the phone and only work after the story; see Gameplay Mechanics for how cheats unlock.

Bunker on Sharktooth Island, just north of Waning Sands; the code is Joe S. Russo's birth date. Opens the Unidentified Building door.

items.location: Near Manifest Canyon, Kelly County
items.note: Pillar and golden globe ringed by four horse statues with star-chart symbols (one in a traffic cone). Symbols not decoded yet.

items.note: Signpost pointing to Liberty City; WAiNK curiosity, boat needed.

items.note: Drop a knocked-out NPC on the blood pentagram; a demon rises and only fire (Molotovs) kills it.

items.location: Hyde Island, north end of Leonida; explore alone
items.note: Darted, collared and hunted by an armoured sniper with a dog. Win for the Island Poacher FF-50 and cash.

items.location: Northern tip of Little Hardin Island; at night

items.note: Use the bong, then jump into the see-through block for a 'J' (or 'L') baseball cap. Works from Chapter 1.

items.note: Say 'Rock on' to Beelzebub and Dave, join the campfire ritual, beat the Pretender for the Hellspawn Comshot 12.

items.note: Beached cargo ship WAiNK blames for Leonida's plastic flamingos; cash, tattoo, card and scuba gear aboard.

items.location: Compound beside the Riquezas Keys Radome

items.location: Centre of Dalton Island, off Vice Beach
items.note: Bronze rune-covered sculpture (WAiNK scan) plus a Latin plaque echoing Revelation 17:8; unsolved.

items.location: Tiny island in Leonida Bay, far west of Watson Bay
items.note: SOS and #SENDBEER in the sand; the phone by the sign plays a stranded couple's video before something attacks them.

items.location: Swamp edge by the north road, east of Cottonmouth Lake, Grassrivers
items.note: Hidden stranger fresh from a San Andreas desert festival; tells you to come back in a few days.

items.location: Stone ruins on the east side of Mount Kalaga National Park, just west of Lake Tallaloko
items.note: Rune and the word 'Bigness' under the bell; WAiNK landmark entry about an Illuminati sacrifice video.

items.location: Sassafras Road, east Lummox County, off the northern highway toward Millport; at night, alone

items.location: Under the raised highway, south side of the Vice Decor District, Vice City

items.note: Toggles the siren and light bar together. Left stick up is the manual siren tone; down is the horn. No confirmed lights-only toggle.

items.location: Front parking lot
items.note: Grab a vehicle and lose the two-star wanted level.

items.location: Rear fence
items.note: Quiet way out of the bowling alley compound.

items.location: Click L3 + R3
items.note: Highlights nearby notes, maps, and keypad clues. You can also aim at an employee and ask for a safe code.

items.location: Sticky bombs, or the right-stick crack prompt
items.note: Explosives can damage some contents and will alert enemies. Many operation sites have bomb crates nearby, or buy them at Ammu-Nation.

items.location: Written on-site each time
items.note: GameSpot found ordinary store and robbery keypad codes change between visits, so lists cannot give those numbers.

items.location: Fences listed under Shops
items.note: Some pay at a drop box later, others pay immediately. You can also send your partner to fence goods for a smaller cut.

items.location: Finish the main story at least once
items.note: Then open the phone, hold L1 + R1, and enter a D-pad sequence. Using a cheat disables saving afterwards. Many cheats also need a challenge completed.

items.location: $250,000: Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right
items.note: The only money cheat GameSpot lists. Story must already be finished; do not use it if you still want to save.

items.location: Stash under Jason's bedroom floor, or BuckMe once you have the account
items.note: Carried cash is lost if you are killed or busted.

items.location: Outdoor wall ATMs; tow truck behind the Atomic auto parts yard, Hamlet (SE of Boone Speedway)
items.note: Hook the ATM, drive forward, reverse, forward, then finish on foot; about $7,200 marked bills on one run. Dye packs can ruin the take.

items.location: Map > Vehicles > Mod Shops (area must be uncovered)
items.note: 14 shops, each a specialist; repair a damaged car first. Mods on Jason's Chapter 1 car are lost when the story replaces it.

items.location: Hold Circle (PS5) / B (Xbox) on the main menu
items.note: Tapping only backs up one level; holding leaves the wardrobe, gun shop or garage loadout.

items.location: Check your registered personal car's trunk
items.note: Bags can be auto-moved there when you get in a car or after a cutscene; a bag badge on the car's map icon shows it.

items.location: Settings > Gameplay > Movement
items.note: Level 1 caps you at a walk; set level 4. Standard layout: click L3 to jog, again to sprint. Classic layout: tap X (PS5) / A (Xbox).

items.location: Turn the right stick slowly
items.note: Wait for the second, stronger rumble before reeling; if the stick never works, switch reeling to a button in settings.

items.item: Flip a car / push a boat
items.location: Stand beside it, click L3, hold Square (PS5) / X (Xbox)
items.note: Rights overturned cars and shoves beached boats or jet skis; fails if too heavy, on steep slopes, or out of stamina.

items.location: Hold Circle (PS5) / B (Xbox) on foot
items.note: Sits on grass or sand, leans on walls or rails, or dips feet at a dock or pool.

items.location: Set waypoint, hold D-pad Down, Options for cinematic cam, then hold Circle
items.note: Car (or boat) drives itself to the marker; hold D-pad Down to take back control.

items.location: Hold D-pad Up, aim at a car, hold R1
items.note: Shows lock/Key Cloner need, alarm, tracker, sell value and registration cost before you steal it.

items.location: Double-tap Triangle (PS5) / Y (Xbox)
items.note: Exit with the engine on; at speed the car keeps rolling.

items.location: Hold Circle (PS5) / B (Xbox) in a vehicle
items.note: Ducks down out of sight.

items.location: Hold L2 (PS5) / LT (Xbox), then press R3
items.note: Look through Jason or Lucia's eyes without moving; handy for reading signs and posters.

items.location: Press Square while driving
items.note: Swings your door into anyone beside the car.

items.location: Pause map shading
items.note: Dark blue buildings can be entered; pale blue ones are generally shut.

items.location: Hobbies: fishing, pool, golf, basketball, meditation, shooting range
items.note: All extend Focus over time; coffee and tea refill it faster.

items.location: Hold D-pad Left, push right stick down
items.note: X plays a show, Square browses episodes.

items.item: Pay 'n' Spray paint vs mod shop
items.location: Respraying a car
items.note: TheGamer reports a Pay 'n' Spray respray looks blistered and less glossy than a full mod-garage paint job.

items.item: Hide from police in the Chapter 3 apartment
items.location: Vice City apartment, free roam with white stars
items.note: One Reddit report: officers entered the building but never breached the door, and the wanted level cleared. Single report.

items.location: Double-tap Triangle (PS5) / Y (Xbox) at the helm
items.note: The boat keeps going straight while you walk the deck.

items.location: Hold R2 (RT) halfway, to the adaptive trigger's first click
items.note: Handy for avoiding police attention on long drives.

items.location: Buy earbuds or headphones, then equip them
items.note: Lets you listen to the radio while walking.

items.location: Hold Triangle (PS5) / Y (Xbox) by a rear door
items.note: Useful when your partner is waiting at the wheel.

items.item: Hand a stash bag to your partner
items.location: Hold D-pad Right, press Circle (PS5) / B (Xbox)
items.note: Lets one trip carry more bags.

items.location: Tell your partner 'you drive' after a robbery
items.note: They flee and lose the cops for you; ask before the robbery so they wait in the car.

items.location: D-pad Left / Right while aiming
items.note: Swaps the camera shoulder for cover angles.

items.location: Earned in the Chapter 3 mission Meet the Heders
items.note: Permanent tool for Jason and Lucia that cuts padlocks on SCOOP shipping containers, several of which hide rare cars.

items.item: Dive underwater to lose the cops
items.location: Any deep water
items.note: Police struggle to find you underwater; stars start blinking at 2-3 stars while you stay down on your air meter. Didn't work at 6 stars.

items.location: Item wheel (international versions only)
items.note: Elsewhere you can skim bricks into baggies for a ~30-second stamina boost. The Australian/NZ build (and PS5 NZ-store copies) lacks it; adrenaline still works.

steps.title: Open the vehicle menu
steps.detail: While in a vehicle, hold D-pad Left. If Radio opens first, push the right stick up to switch to the Vehicle tab.

steps.title: Headlights and the light bar
steps.detail: In the Vehicle tab, set Headlights to Automatic, Low Beam, High Beam, or Off. In a police vehicle, click L3 (PS5) or the left stick (Xbox) to toggle the siren and light bar together.

steps.title: Kingpin Bowling escape
steps.detail: Front parking lot for a car getaway, or stealth out via the rear fence. Leaving triggers a two-star wanted level.

categories.heading: Glitches and Bugs
categories.caption: Every entry from the scan file /workspace/gta6-glitches/seen.json (119 entries, file updated 26 Nov 2026, 3:05 PM AEST), plus extra reports found by research. Rockstar's first post-launch update, 01.002.002, came out on 23 Nov 2026 (US time) with official patch notes; see its entry below. Fixes listed there are noted on the matching bugs.

items.item: Prologue: Lucia falls through the map after being tased
items.location: Prologue arrest, PS5 / Xbox Series
items.note: Often teleports back to the police sequence; otherwise restart or replay the mission.

items.item: Gone Fishing: boat ram has no NPC or vehicle reaction
items.location: Gone Fishing
items.note: Ramming a speedboat into an NPC boat produced no crash, capsize, or reaction.

items.item: Gone Fishing: missing plane door / clip into seat
items.location: Gone Fishing, getaway plane
items.note: No door-opening animation; Jason clips through the fuselage into the pilot seat.

items.location: Using a fridge
items.note: A can or bottle pops into existence instead of coming off a shelf.

items.item: Stolen plane crash: no explosion, unharmed exit
items.location: Police chase in a large plane
items.note: Planes slide through buildings without exploding. Usually the Reduced Vehicle Damage option (Settings > Gameplay, off by default); turn it off and planes explode, though big jets keep the fuselage intact.

items.location: Fight with an officer, reported in a station / around a couch
items.note: Characters overlap and get sucked into furniture or a wall; reports say letting it play out usually frees you.

items.location: Hitting a swing set or similar object
items.note: Vehicle can be launched a long way and wrecked. Not confirmed as a repeatable exploit.

items.location: Jumping out of a plane early
items.note: Abandoned plane can lose physics and phase through buildings.

items.item: Survive a plane bailout with no parachute or damage
items.location: Police chase, jumping with no chute
items.note: Player lands unharmed; in the reported clip the plane itself does explode.

items.item: Lucia falls through terrain, dies, respawns elsewhere
items.location: Free roam / terrain clip
items.note: Related to, but described differently from, the prologue taser clip. Exact trigger not clearly documented.

items.location: Several early clips, mixed platforms
items.note: Includes a boat jammed in a Keys-style bridge, a passenger stuck in an Annis Hellion door, cage-mesh camera clip, tattoo-studio counter clip, bodies sinking into asphalt, and Lucia falling through a prison floor.

items.location: Intro / just before the prologue; reported on Xbox Series X
items.note: Vehicles and NPCs pop in and world textures go missing.

items.location: Free roam on a mobility scooter
items.note: Reported as unusually hard to crash; may be exaggerated physics rather than a classic glitch.

items.item: Ship / vehicle pop-in on a bridge
items.location: Driving on a bridge (one writeup: Drive to the radar station)
items.note: A ship or stacked vehicles appear jammed against or on the bridge, then shift oddly.

items.item: NPCs walk into walls and get stuck
items.location: Free roam, review build
items.note: Minor, not game-breaking; seen in pre-release reviews, not confirmed fixed on the launch build.

items.item: Floating coffee cup when switching characters
items.location: Safehouse character switch, review build
items.note: Shacknews reported an otherwise clean review apart from this one visual bug.

items.item: Phone in a tight spot drops Jason through the map
items.location: Squeeze between a car and a fence, then open the phone
items.note: A restart was reportedly needed; make a manual save first. Original post was not independently found by the scan.

items.item: Crashes or reboots wiping progress despite autosave
items.location: Unspecified
items.note: Reported progress loss after a crash or reboot. Update 01.002.002 lists crash fixes and an autosave fix.

items.location: Physics / collision
items.note: A truck is launched a long distance after a collision.

items.location: PS5
items.note: Dexerto describes a glitch that lets players access first-person mode; details beyond the headline were not in the scan file.

items.location: Red barn stash; PS5 / Xbox Series
items.note: Cocaine or cash respawns after a manual save and reload if bags stay in the vehicle trunk; fence at Brian's Lockup. Unpatched in the scan file.

items.item: Coming Home: pool break with Mattia does not register
items.location: Coming Home, Xbox
items.note: Softlock when the pool shot does not register. From our chats and the scan file.

items.location: Early Lucia mission, after leaving a bank
items.note: Cutscene does not start; softlock.

items.location: In water
items.note: Swimming animation plays on the wrong axis.

items.location: Early game, under 15 minutes in
items.note: Player can get stuck inside a fenced area with no clear exit.

items.item: Boat wedged between bridge supports moves erratically
items.location: Bridge supports
items.note: Wedged boat behaves oddly.

items.item: Riderless motorbikes keep chasing after a mission reset
items.location: After a mission reset
items.note: Bikes continue the chase with no riders.

items.item: Traffic or cars vanish in front of the player
items.location: Traffic
items.note: Vehicles despawn or disappear ahead of the camera.

items.item: Xbox flickering lighting and blocky textures
items.location: Xbox Series X|S
items.note: Lighting flicker and blocky or corrupted textures.

items.item: PS5 CE-108255-1 crash in the prologue
items.location: Prologue, PS5
items.note: Crash with that error code. GamesRadar suggests updating the game; no official Rockstar notes.

items.item: NPC SUV frozen mid-air beside a Keys bridge
items.location: The Keys, elevated bridge
items.note: A traffic SUV hangs motionless in the air and despawns when you drive away.

items.item: Fishing rod falls through the boat and is lost
items.location: Fishing from a boat
items.note: The rod clips through the hull and is lost.

items.item: Prologue: cannot aim at the cashier
items.location: Prologue hold-up
items.note: LT / L2 does nothing when trying to aim at the cashier.

items.item: Gone Fishing: Jason stuck inside a cage
items.location: After the Kingfishers fight in Gone Fishing; PS5 and Xbox
items.note: Trapped in a wire-mesh cage with no exit. Workaround: retry the checkpoint, or load a save from before the mission. Found in the 21 Nov research update; not in the 20 Nov scan file.

items.item: Xbox Quick Resume unlocks the framerate
items.location: Xbox Series X, 120Hz display, version 01.002.001
items.note: Start at 60Hz, switch to 120Hz at the intro, cold-boot another game, then resume: 60+ FPS but double-speed gameplay. RockstarINTEL says 01.002.002 did not patch it.

items.location: Flooded swamp yard, PS5
items.note: An alligator glides high above the water for several seconds. Harmless; unconfirmed, unpatched as of 21 Nov.

items.location: Apollo Aggregates warehouse, South Vice-Dale County
items.note: Loot about $8,000, store it in the car, save and load to warp home, then cash out at Brian's; a video claims about $4,000 per five minutes.

items.location: Stores near Jason's house
items.note: Rob them, lose the cops, start any story mission, choose Restart Mission at the cutscene, then quit: the stores reopen with new loot.

items.item: PS5 black flickering boxes and broken water
items.location: Base PS5, all gameplay
items.note: Camo-like black boxes flicker over the screen and water turns into blocks. Try updates, VRR/120Hz off, Safe Mode rebuild. Unconfirmed.

items.item: Unwanted Attention: garage disguise won't register
items.location: Brian's garage, Chapter 1
items.note: Hat/glasses change doesn't tick and the door stays shut. Fixes: release L1/LB so the wheel closes, take the $150 first, or buy new clothes and restart.

items.location: End of Chapter 2, after Afternoon Delight
items.note: No Move to Vice City call; check Prepare for Vice City's money target (Family Savings too). No confirmed fix.

items.location: Gym at Jason's house / a story mission
items.note: Holding LT+RT does nothing. Rockstar's 01.002.002 notes list a fix for the gym deadlift bar; before that, a controller reset helped one PS5 player.

items.location: Pipework, PS5
items.note: Game closes when using the plunger. Setting PS5 video output to 1080p instead of Automatic fixed it for one player.

items.item: Bicycle won't move at Jason's house
items.location: Jason's house, PS5
items.note: Bike stops responding. Bunny-hop and fall off, then use another vehicle.

items.location: Any gun store, PS5 / Xbox Series
items.note: Two players lost the unique revolver after buying a standard .38. Save first; reload an earlier save to get it back.

items.item: Pickup rear plate flickers on dirt roads
items.location: Swamp back roads, chase camera
items.note: Cosmetic. Walk away until the car is off screen and come back, or restart the game.

items.item: PS5 rest mode stops quest calls (unconfirmed)
items.location: PS5, resuming from rest mode
items.note: One player says story calls stop until the game is fully closed and restarted, then arrive all at once.

items.location: Reddit report, details unclear
items.note: A glitch stripped Lucia's clothes entirely; screenshots only, no trigger known.

items.location: Wardrobe at the start of Chapter 2
items.note: Clothes and hats bought in Chapter 1 vanish. Re-buy them from the Key Lento shops, which stay open.

items.item: Stash bag vanishes in a car or cutscene
items.location: Any stash bag pickup
items.note: Gone from map and trunk though the money screen may count it; usually moved to your registered car's trunk.

items.item: Stuck in wardrobe / gun shop / loadout menu
items.location: Customisation screens
items.note: Mostly input: hold Circle / B instead of tapping it.

items.item: Phone apps won't open except BuckMe
items.location: Jason's phone, Xbox
items.note: Apps show 'unavailable'; keep pressing the app until it opens.

items.location: Prologue (boat sequence, intro cutscene, after the escape)
items.note: Confirmed on both consoles. One Xbox fix: play via Xbox Cloud Gaming. See also the PS5 CE-108255-1 entry.

items.item: Meet the Heders: crates can't be used
items.location: Dockyard, Meet the Heders
items.note: Lucia won't interact and the mission stalls; Pause > Restart Mission fixed it.

items.item: Chapter 3: Jason greyed out after Missing Persons
items.location: Kelly County Missing Persons case
items.note: Stuck as Lucia with no mission. Load a manual save from before the final Port Gellhorn warehouse meeting.

items.item: No Raul call after Photo Shoot / Heavy Lifting
items.location: Chapter 4 story calls
items.note: Update 01.002.002 fixes story and mission phone calls not triggering. Otherwise finish and sell all 3 Yasmani jewelry jobs and fully restart.

items.item: Fully Catered crash at the delivery cutscene
items.location: Fully Catered, PS5 / Xbox Series
items.note: Freezes on the first frame and crashes. Load a save from before the mission was offered.

items.location: After Randy's text
items.note: Progression gate: deliver 17 wish-list cars and finish Photo/Shoot (Chapter 4), then wait for Randy's call.

items.location: PS5 01.002.002 (about 604 MB) / Xbox 1.0.2.2 (about 1.6 GB)
items.note: Rockstar notes: crash fixes, weather stuck for long periods, autosave, phone calls not triggering, Wanted Level not clearing, gym deadlift bar, partners not handing over bags for fences. Xbox 60 FPS glitch not patched.

items.location: Free roam, PS5 / Xbox Series
items.note: Blurry textures and LOD models plus brief freezes while driving since the update. Fully restart the game and console (not Rest Mode or Quick Resume).

items.item: Coming Home crashes before the pool game
items.location: Coming Home, mostly Xbox Series X, at least one PS5
items.note: Repeated crashes around the pool-table scene. Skip every cutscene and keep interactions minimal; one player says it got worse after 1.0.2.2.

items.location: Port Gellhorn garage tunnel, Chapter 3, PS5
items.note: Unconfirmed. Wait a few in-game hours or finish the next story mission, then return.

items.item: Lucia won't get in the car after a heist
items.location: Leaving a heist location, PS5
items.note: Unconfirmed. Drive a few metres to open ground, stop, and let her walk to the car.

items.item: Vanessa's garage keypad gone / Growler missing
items.location: Auntie's Place garage, La Perle
items.note: Use Boobie's laptop clue first (Chapter 3), then 92665; or reload an earlier save and save straight after opening.

items.location: PS5 / Xbox Series
items.note: Usually the Movement speed setting (see Controls): set it to level 4.

items.location: Recalibration, PS5
items.note: Usually technique: turn the right stick slowly and wait for the second rumble, or switch reeling to a button.

items.item: Jason stuck in the shower (invisible curtain)
items.location: Shower at Jason's house; PS5 / Xbox Series
items.note: Jason can be left in the tub, dressed, with the curtain acting as a wall. Reload the last save; save before showering. Unconfirmed.

items.item: Cutscene goes black, audio keeps playing
items.location: Story cutscenes; PS5 / Xbox Series
items.note: Picture drops out mid-scene, then returns or skips to gameplay; not reported as story-blocking.

items.item: Bicycle clips into the floor and launches Jason
items.location: Riding a bicycle
items.note: Bike catches below the surface and rebounds upward. Unverified clip.

items.item: Key Lento Coastal Auto Care out-of-bounds
items.location: Back exterior staircase, Coastal Auto Care, Key Lento
items.note: Stand next to the worker on the top landing to get pushed inside and under the map; save first. Unconfirmed.

items.item: Alvan West mine encounter: subtitles, no voice
items.location: Abandoned mine after Missing Persons
items.note: Doesn't block progress. Check Dialogue Volume, or fully restart and retrigger.

items.item: Bricked Up won't start (Boobie never calls)
items.location: Chapter 3, Bayside apartment
items.note: It starts with a scene: as Jason, go to the apartment bedroom where Boobie sleeps (Hidden Charges must be done).

items.item: Car changes paint after Scooter Bros delivery
items.location: Owned car delivered by Scooter Bros
items.note: Comes back with other paint and tints and flagged unregistered with a tracker. Store it and take it out, or fully restart.

items.item: Criminal profile stuck on Violent / Hardened
items.location: Jason or Lucia's criminal profile
items.note: Moves slowly: stop killing cops and fleeing civilians and give it several missions.

items.item: Lucia's Don't Trip leather jacket vanishes
items.location: After Girls' Trip, motel cutscene
items.note: No store sells it. Save it as an outfit at a store wardrobe before returning to the motel.

items.item: DualSense Edge adaptive triggers don't work
items.location: PS5, DualSense Edge
items.note: Set both trigger stops to full length, or use a profile with full-range trigger dead zones.

items.item: Cal's fish request: no photo option
items.location: Fishing for Cal's texted species
items.note: Prompt needs his request active for that spot; wait until the spot is available and catch it again.

items.item: Input lag when driving and aiming
items.location: PS5 / Xbox Series
items.note: TV Game Mode on, motion smoothing off, ALLM on. Base PS5 owners also report HDCP off helps, and FPS dips to 15-25 in big fights.

items.item: Jason stays sweaty after the nightclub mission
items.location: Jason, any outfit
items.note: Showers don't help; sleep 6+ hours at a safehouse or switch to Lucia and back.

items.item: Kyle ignores you after you hit him
items.location: McKittrick Farm side missions
items.note: Leave the farm and wait a couple of in-game days for his text, or load an earlier save.

items.item: Lucia keeps the yellow hazmat gloves
items.location: After Buddy? (Check on Kyle)
items.note: Wardrobe changes and reloads don't remove them; buy a complete outfit in a clothing store.

items.item: Max strength + max fat resets Lucia's build
items.location: Lucia, 5/5 strength, PS5
items.note: Body snaps back to low muscle, low fat. Keep Strength at 4/5 for a heavier build.

items.location: Brian's Dodo seaplane and stolen jets
items.note: Audio bug, not a real warning; turn SFX volume down while flying.

items.location: Kordell's planning room, Help Kordell's Crew
items.note: The front is a decoy workout plan; use Focus on the board first, then flip it.

items.item: PS5 won't power on after long sessions
items.location: PS5 (also CE-108262-9 shutdowns)
items.note: Console stays dark, controller blinks. Do a full power reset (unplug); likely PSU or heat protection.

items.item: Rain on Jason's shirt indoors; clothes never get wet
items.location: Ocean View Hotel and in water
items.note: Visual only; changing outfit or reloading the area may clear it.

items.item: Randy's wish list: self-found Thrax pays nothing
items.location: Thrax from the speedway trailer, before Randy's tip
items.note: List breaks, no payout or trophy. Load an autosave from before and deliver the Thrax he points you to.

items.location: Since update 01.002.002
items.note: Only the default shape shows; re-apply the setting.

items.item: Camera stuck after a crash cam
items.location: PS5, after the crash camera
items.note: Right stick does nothing for a while; look behind to re-centre or wait it out.

items.item: Saved outfits load the wrong accessories
items.location: Wardrobe outfits
items.note: Hat, mask or glasses swap and a vest overwrites the jacket; take the vest off before saving.

items.item: Swamped freezes on the jump to Lori's airboat
items.location: Swamped, Chapter 1
items.note: Game crashes mid-jump; kill the kidnapper from the helicopter instead.

items.item: The Final Flush: Dr. Merle loops one animation
items.location: Sewage plant gate, No Flushers side mission
items.note: Save on the spot and load that save to retrigger the script.

items.location: Some junctions; auto-drive waits forever
items.note: Waiting 10+ minutes doesn't help; drive through yourself.

items.item: Vice City portal: no text after the 12th substation
items.location: LPL substation Easter egg
items.note: A death, refuel or fast travel mid-run resets it; do a clean rerun as Jason.

items.item: Gentrifier wrestling won't start (no knock prompt)
items.location: Trailer park, west Hamlet
items.note: Throw something at the trailer door, then knock.

items.item: Dubious Provenance: Halifax escapes, no statue
items.location: End-of-mission chase, Chapter 3
items.note: Mission just ends without the reward; only a save from before the mission brings it back.

items.item: No missions after Meet the Heders
items.location: Chapter 3, Halifax goes to voicemail
items.note: Next step is a text on Lucia's phone (blocked number); restart the game and check as Lucia.

items.item: Bought garages missing from the map
items.location: Owned garages
items.note: Open each garage once from the real-estate app.

items.item: Xbox Series X shuts off every 10-15 minutes
items.location: Since update 01.002.002
items.note: Console powers off (heat or power protection); give it air and plug it straight into the wall.

items.item: Tie Up Loose Ends won't start
items.location: After VCIA Takedown, PS5
items.note: Valentina never calls; save, restart the game and roam outside the Y Hotel as Lucia.

items.location: After the first mission, Xbox
items.note: Engine only tries to start, bike pedals in place; check controls and accessibility settings.

items.item: Yasmani won't sell a new tip
items.location: After the Cash and Carry score
items.note: Save, reload, then look for the green 'i' marker on the map. Unconfirmed.

items.location: PS5 / PS5 Pro, seconds after starting
items.note: Delete the game, rebuild the database, reinstall; often follows installing on a nearly full SSD.

items.location: Heist prep board shows the job twice
items.note: Crashes with CE-108255-1; not fixed by 01.002.002. Load a save from before the job appeared.

items.item: Donnie doesn't pay for the drugs
items.location: Drop at Donnie's trailer, Key Lento
items.note: Not lost: it lands in the mailbox at Jason's house after more story (next Brian mission), or as a BuckMe transfer.

items.item: Steal the Zorrusso (Key Cloner) never unlocks
items.location: Randy's calls, Chapter 3+
items.note: Randy phones Lucia, not Jason; play as Lucia in free roam until he calls.

items.item: Practice on the Safe stays on the map
items.location: Lucia's safe practice, Cartel Heist
items.note: The marker is repeatable; carry on with the other heist objectives.

items.location: Xbox, 1.59 GB update
items.note: Don't cancel (it uninstalled the game for one player); leave it 10-60 minutes.

items.location: Chapter 1
items.note: Not a bug: play the next story marker (Donnie's package / bank account) instead.

items.item: Red dot stuck mid-screen in free roam
items.location: PS5
items.note: Usually the Persistent Center Dot reticle setting; turn it off.

items.item: Car Service: Schafter V12 not registered
items.location: Steal the Car for Raul, Chapter 3
items.note: Often the wrong car: take the plain saloon next to the red big-engine one.

items.item: Karim never calls for the bank heist
items.location: Before the Sinfrontera National Bank heist
items.note: Progression gate: play Ride or Die and Lucia's Cooties first.

items.item: Breakfast Run won't start after Slam Dunk
items.location: Chapter 2
items.note: Usually another main mission (often Daily Driver) is pending; skip a few days, reload and drive around.

items.location: Xbox Series X|S
items.note: Sometimes with frame drops; no reliable fix yet.

items.location: Xbox, game started offline
items.note: Needs an online licence check; go online, then fully restart.

items.item: Moses request stuck after the car is wrecked
items.location: Chapter 2 car list
items.note: Wait for it at the impound lot; if it isn't there, skip that car.

items.item: Ghosting trails when turning the camera
items.location: Most visible on Xbox Series X
items.note: Change the TV's motion settings and lower Motion Blur Strength.

items.item: Quick-menu hat or glasses go on both characters
items.location: Jason's quick menu
